MRP.description: Must be declared as 'Maximum Retail Price' or 'MRP' followed by price value in Rupees and mandatory statutory statement 'inclusive of all taxes' or 'incl. of all taxes'.
MRP.clause: Rule 6(1)(da) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

NetQuantity.description: Must declare net weight, volume, or count in standard metric units (g, kg, ml, l, N, pcs). Non-standard units (e.g. gms, box) are non-compliant.
NetQuantity.clause: Rule 6(1)(c) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

MfgDate.description: Must declare month and year in which commodity was manufactured, packed, or imported.
MfgDate.clause: Rule 6(1)(d) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

Manufacturer.description: Must declare complete name and postal address of the manufacturer, packer, or importer.
Manufacturer.clause: Rule 6(1)(a) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

ConsumerCare.description: Must declare name/designation, address, telephone helpline number, AND email address for consumer grievance redressal.
ConsumerCare.clause: Rule 6(1)(g) of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011

font_size_rules.description: Minimum height of numerals and letters for declarations under Rule 7
font_size_rules.clause: Rule 7 of Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
